I was refused disability assessment today , despite repeated requests, when I went in person( within 9am to 12pm assessment time). I was told by the person who checks forms that I should have taken prior appointment even though I had called one day before and was told appt not required. When I requested the doctor on duty and his asst they made me do about 3-4 movements against resistance and said I  would not get a disability certificate as I don't meet the criteria. They decided this without even doing a full assessment and despite me showing them notes from my orthopedics and physiotherapists over the years saying I have disability/describing my disabilities. I also showed them my 3D biometric assessment and surgery picture. They refused to give details of criteria under which they are rejecting me and said if you want still want assessment you will have to come again.

So not only they did not give me assessment but also told me even if I come again I won't meet their criteria. I called and emailed in advance, travelled 1.5hr each way and spent rs900+ for this (as I cannot travel in buses/trains due to my disability). Now I will again have to do the same and may possibly be rejected.

I feel not only is this harassment to the disabled but also being subjective about who gets the disability certificate as even the the final percentage is computer generated, the people who enter these can have biased view. Where I can complain about all this?

There are some people whom God sends into our lives as angels in human form, and for our family, Dr. Vidhi and Dr. Vineet have truly been those angels.

When daughter had a fall from 25ft .our world shattered. She had suffered four pelvic fractures and an elbow fracture. After surgery, she was on a catheter, unable to even get up on her own. As parents, watching our daughter in that condition was heartbreaking beyond words. The fear, pain, and helplessness we felt every single day cannot be described.

But then Dr. Vidhi and Dr. Vineet entered our lives with not only medical expertise, but with warmth, affection, patience, and hope. They did not just treat daughter physically — they healed her emotionally and mentally too. Every session was filled with encouragement, positivity, and genuine care. They treated her like their own family.

Slowly, step by step, with their dedication and holistic approach, they brought our daughter back to life. The child who once could not even sit or stand is today smiling, moving, and living again because of their relentless efforts and blessings. What felt impossible to us became possible because of them.

I can proudly and confidently say that their physiotherapy rehabilitation is among the very best in India. But beyond their knowledge and skills, it is their humanity, compassion, and selfless dedication that make them truly extraordinary.

For the rest of our lives, our family will remain grateful to Dr. Vidhi and Dr. Vineet. They have not only healed our daughter’s body, but they have restored happiness, hope, and strength to our entire family.

May God bless them with endless happiness, success, health, and strength so they can continue transforming many more lives the way they transformed ours.
